eventDetail.scope: The 8th International Conference on New Trends in Computational Intelligence (NTCI 2026) publishes original articles on emerging aspects of computational intelligence, including theory, applications, and surveys. Authors are encouraged to submit original, previously unpublished innovative work in any area of Computational Intelligence, both new trends which form the theme of the conference as well as more foundational areas.
